## Project Overview
Travel agency website (Travel World) with home page, destinations, visa services, blog, about, contact, and service pages. Built with PHP, with URL rewriting via .htaccess.

## Completed Work
- **Phase 1**: destinations/index.php (list page with filter), destinations/country.php (single template), data files for 16 home destinations, .htaccess URL rewriting
- **Phase 4**: about.php, contact.php
- **Phase 3**: services/index.php + service.php template
- **Phase 5**: blog/index.php + blog/post.php
- **Shared includes**: includes/page-header.php + page-footer.php, assets/css/inner.css + assets/js/inner.js (light theme + WA forms)
- **INNER_PAGES_PLAN.md** created
- **Visa section**: visa section on home page (index.php), visa/index.php, visa/visa.php template, visa/data/ files for USA, UK, Schengen, Canada, Australia, Dubai, Singapore, Thailand, Japan, New Zealand, .htaccess rule for /visa/[country], visa links added to header nav + footer (both header.php and page-header.php)
- **New destinations**: China, Hong Kong, South Korea, Taiwan data files created; destinations/index.php hero redesigned + new destinations added
- **Europe missing data files**: lisbon, iceland, rome, venice, mykonos — CREATED
- **Americas missing data files**: peru, rio, cancun, costa-rica, new-york, patagonia — CREATED
- **Africa missing data files**: tanzania, cape-town, zanzibar, kenya, cairo, seychelles, mauritius — CREATED
- **Oceania missing data files**: new-zealand, fiji, bora-bora, australia — CREATED
- **maldives.php** — updated with full content
- **index.php destination cards**: Added JS snippet + CSS to make entire `.dest-card-new` cards clickable via an injected `.dest-card-link-overlay` anchor element. Task completed.

## Key Technical Decisions
- URL rewriting via .htaccess for clean URLs (/destinations/[slug], /visa/[country], etc.)
- PHP template pattern: single template file (country.php, visa.php) reads slug from URL, includes matching data file
- Light theme for inner pages via inner.css; dark/hero theme on home page
- WhatsApp enquiry forms in inner.js
- Destination cards on home page use `.dest-card-new` class with horizontal scroll
- Card overlay link pattern: JS injects `<a class="dest-card-link-overlay">` as first child of each card, with `aria-hidden="true"` and `tabindex="-1"`; overlay uses `position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1`; `.dest-card-info` set to `z-index: 2` so title link and "Enquire →" button remain clickable above overlay

## Relevant Files & Code
- `index.php` — Home page; visa section, destinations scroll section with `.dest-card-new` cards; JS overlay snippet added after `<!-- /dest-scroll-outer -->`
- `destinations/index.php` — Destinations list with filter, redesigned hero
- `destinations/country.php` — Single destination template
- `destinations/data/` — Individual destination PHP data files (maldives, bali, paris, dubai, singapore, thailand, japan, new-zealand, china, hong-kong, south-korea, taiwan, lisbon, iceland, rome, venice, mykonos, peru, rio, cancun, costa-rica, new-york, patagonia, tanzania, cape-town, zanzibar, kenya, cairo, seychelles, mauritius, fiji, bora-bora, australia, etc.)
- `visa/index.php`, `visa/visa.php`, `visa/data/` — Visa pages and data
- `services/index.php`, `services/service.php` — Services pages
- `blog/index.php`, `blog/post.php` — Blog pages
- `about.php`, `contact.php` — Static inner pages
- `includes/page-header.php`, `includes/page-footer.php` — Shared header/footer with visa nav links
- `assets/css/inner.css`, `assets/js/inner.js` — Inner page styles and scripts
- `.htaccess` — URL rewriting rules

**JS overlay snippet (added to index.php after dest-scroll-outer):**
```js
document.querySelectorAll('.dest-card-new').forEach(function(card) {
    var link = card.querySelector('h3 a');
    if (!link) return;
    var href = link.getAttribute('href');
    var overlay = document.createElement('a');
    overlay.href = href;
    overlay.className = 'dest-card-link-overlay';
    overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    overlay.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
    card.insertBefore(overlay, card.firstChild);
});
```

## Current Status
All tasks completed. The destination cards on the home page are now fully clickable — clicking anywhere on the card navigates to the destination detail page. The overlay anchor covers the full card (z-index: 1) while `.dest-card-info` sits above (z-index: 2) so the title link and enquire button remain independently clickable. All reminder tasks marked Completed.
